character.lasthorizon.title: Create your character
character.lasthorizon.name: Name
character.lasthorizon.confirm.title: Journey Summary
character.lasthorizon.confirm.text: %s will be saved in this world and cannot be changed later.
character.lasthorizon.created.wish: May the winds of the Grand Line blow in your favor.
character.lasthorizon.reset: %s's character was erased; they must create a new one.
character.lasthorizon.tab.0.desc: Your character's name, epithet and gender.
character.lasthorizon.tab.1.desc: Skin color, eyes, face and adornments.
character.lasthorizon.tab.2.desc: Hair color and style, and the beard.
character.lasthorizon.tab.3.desc: Your outfit, an accessory and its color.
character.lasthorizon.random.desc: Randomizes appearance, personality, age, and home sea (plus a name if empty). Gender, epithet, and motto stay unchanged. Rolling the soul spends a roll; with none left, the soul stays as it is. Shift + click: appearance only.
character.lasthorizon.name.empty: Give your character a name, %s to %s characters.
character.lasthorizon.name.short: Too short: use at least %s characters.
character.lasthorizon.name.long: Too long: use at most %s characters.
character.lasthorizon.name.edge: Remove the spaces at the start and end of the name.
character.lasthorizon.name.bad: The character “%s” is not allowed. Use letters, numbers, space, ' or -.
character.lasthorizon.name.ok: Valid name! It shows above your head and in chat.
character.lasthorizon.gender.note: Gender changes the body model (slimmer arms) and some face details.
character.lasthorizon.confirm.warn: Once sealed, the character is saved in this world for good.
character.lasthorizon.tab.4.desc: Your personality on six axes. Spin the Soul to roll your traits and reveal your destiny.
character.lasthorizon.tab.5.desc: Your age (humans only), home sea, and motto.
character.lasthorizon.soul.5.0.strength: Sees the world as it is
character.lasthorizon.soul.5.1.strength: Sees horizons no one else sees
Reads the sky before the storm
Keeps the crew out of harm
Never backs down from a fight
Finds the way to any shore
character.lasthorizon.soul.3.1.flaw.1: Cannot let go of the past
Lifts the mood of any crew
Has a story for every port
character.lasthorizon.soul.4.1.flaw.2: Talks too much at bad times
Spots a bad plan at once
character.lasthorizon.soul.5.0.flaw.3: Never takes a leap of faith
character.lasthorizon.soul.balanced.stre: Sees both sides of a fight
character.lasthorizon.size.0.note: How many blocks tall the character is, from 1.5 to 2.5 (the default is 1.8). The width follows the height: the whole body grows together, in proportion. Drag the slider or use the mouse wheel.
character.lasthorizon.size.1.note: Bust size of the female character. 100% is the current size (the maximum); drag the slider or use the mouse wheel.
character.lasthorizon.age.phase.0.desc: Young: full of energy, with the whole world ahead.
character.lasthorizon.age.phase.1.desc: Adult: in their prime, with strength and judgment in balance.
character.lasthorizon.age.phase.2.desc: Seasoned: many storms behind them, and the eyes of someone who has seen it all.
character.lasthorizon.age.phase.3.desc: Veteran: a legend of the seas, with more stories than scars.
character.lasthorizon.sheet.title: %s's sheet
character.lasthorizon.sheet.basic: Human, %s years old (%s), born in the %s
character.lasthorizon.sheet.none: You have not created a character yet.
character.lasthorizon.hair_style.0.desc: Short and practical, stays out of the way on deck.
character.lasthorizon.hair_style.2.desc: Spiked strands that defy the wind.
character.lasthorizon.hair_style.3.desc: A lock falls over the forehead.
character.lasthorizon.face_style.1.desc: A firm brow joined to every eye type.
character.lasthorizon.face_style.2.desc: An old, healed scar crossing the right eye without touching it.
character.lasthorizon.outfit.0.desc: Loose shirt, buckled belt and boots.
character.lasthorizon.outfit.1.desc: Open vest, sash at the waist and shorts.
character.lasthorizon.outfit.2.desc: Stripes, collar and a red scarf.
character.lasthorizon.outfit.5.desc: Simple, plain pieces in the outfit color.
character.lasthorizon.trait.0.0.desc: Prefers to weigh the risks before acting.
character.lasthorizon.trait.1.0.desc: Decides with a cool head and weighs every step.
character.lasthorizon.trait.3.0.desc: Accepts no chains and no imposed course.
character.lasthorizon.trait.3.1.desc: Stays by the crew's side to the end.
character.lasthorizon.trait.4.0.desc: Trusts their own strength and sails alone.
character.lasthorizon.trait.4.1.desc: Makes friends and fights beside them.
character.lasthorizon.trait.5.0.desc: Sees the world as it is.
character.lasthorizon.soul.hint: You do not choose the soul: spin to roll the six traits and reveal your destiny. You have five rolls.
character.lasthorizon.progress.hint: Click a step to jump to it.
character.lasthorizon.clear.desc: Clears this step and restores its defaults. Keep the cursor over the button for 15 seconds to see this hint.
character.lasthorizon.clear.soul.locked: With no rolls left, the soul cannot be cleared: the traits you rolled stay.
character.lasthorizon.name.random.desc: Rolls a name to start with. You can edit it afterwards.
character.lasthorizon.portrait.caption: Your future starts here.
character.lasthorizon.view.zoom_in.desc: Also: mouse wheel over the portrait.
character.lasthorizon.view.zoom_out.desc: Also: mouse wheel over the portrait.
character.lasthorizon.view.flip.desc: Turns the character. You can also drag the portrait.
character.lasthorizon.skin.note: Skin color applies to the face, arms and legs.
character.lasthorizon.eyes.note: The iris color of both eyes.
character.lasthorizon.age.note: Drag the slider (or use the mouse wheel) to set the age. Age is narrative only: it changes no stats.
character.lasthorizon.sea.note: Birth sea is narrative only: it changes no stats.
character.lasthorizon.sea.0.fact: Fun fact: the most peaceful of the four seas.
character.lasthorizon.sea.1.fact: Fun fact: a land of trade and secrets.
character.lasthorizon.sea.2.fact: Fun fact: winter seems never to end.
character.lasthorizon.sea.3.fact: Fun fact: festivals that last for days.
character.lasthorizon.sea.4.fact: Fun fact: the sea of the greatest treasures and dangers.
character.lasthorizon.motto.edit.desc: Click to open the editor and write with more room.
character.lasthorizon.motto.editor.title: Your motto
character.lasthorizon.motto.editor.note: A short line about who you are.
character.lasthorizon.motto.editor.keys: Enter to finish · Esc to close
character.lasthorizon.finish.ready: All set: you still review the summary before sealing.
character.lasthorizon.confirm.ready: Your journey is about to begin.
character.lasthorizon.confirm.ready.sub: Your character is ready to sail the seas.
character.lasthorizon.confirm.edit: Click a line to go back and change it.
character.lasthorizon.hair_style.5.desc: Tied up high, falls down the back.
character.lasthorizon.hair_style.7.desc: Tall and full at the front.
character.lasthorizon.face_style.4.desc: Lines on the forehead and by the mouth.
character.lasthorizon.face_style.6.desc: An old, healed scar on the left cheek.
character.lasthorizon.face_style.7.desc: Eye bags from too little sleep at sea.
character.lasthorizon.beard.note: The beard uses the hair color.
character.lasthorizon.race.0.desc: Folk of sea and land, born without gifts: what you become depends on what you choose, what you face and who you meet.
character.lasthorizon.race.locked.desc: Only the Human race is available for now. The other slots will open in the future.
character.lasthorizon.race.note: Choose your character's race. For now, only Human.
character.lasthorizon.epithet.empty: Optional: an adventurer nickname, like "Sea Wolf". You can leave it blank.
character.lasthorizon.epithet.ok: Epithet ready. Shown on the portrait, the summary and the sheet.
character.lasthorizon.epithet.random.des: Rolls a sample epithet. You can edit it afterwards.
character.lasthorizon.soul.roll.desc: Rolls all six soul traits. Rolls used: %s/%s. Random also spends one, and clearing the tab gives none back.
character.lasthorizon.soul.tile.unknown: Not rolled yet. Spin the soul to reveal this trait.
character.lasthorizon.hair.note: The color applies to the hair and the beard. See the result in the portrait.
character.lasthorizon.outfit_color.note: The outfit color paints the chosen piece and the belt.
character.lasthorizon.sheet.none.other: %s has not created a character yet.
commands.lasthorizon.devilfruit.grant: %s is now marked as a Devil Fruit user.
commands.lasthorizon.devilfruit.revoke: Removed the Devil Fruit mark and the sea curse from %s.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.0.desc: The usual look: white outside, iris inside.

character.lasthorizon.eye_style.3.desc: The default eye with a line of lashes above.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.4.desc: Marked eyelid and a deep gaze.

character.lasthorizon.eye_style.6.desc: Lashes with the tip flicked outward.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.7.desc: Eyelid, lashes and flicked tips: a strong look.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.8.desc: Wide eyes, double iris and a firm line on top.

character.lasthorizon.eye_style.12.desc: Big irises with a glint in the corner.

character.lasthorizon.eye_style.22.desc: A wide, straight lid and a serious look.

character.lasthorizon.eye_style.26.desc: An iris with a dark rim on both sides.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.27.desc: An iris wrapped in a dark outline.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.28.desc: A pale lid that softens the look.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.29.desc: An iris with a white gleam in the corner.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.30.desc: Eyes pressed to the sides of the face.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.31.desc: White on both sides, iris in the middle.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.33.desc: Large irises with a point of light.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.34.desc: A lid arching over the eye.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.35.desc: An arched lid with stretched tips.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.36.desc: A big arch over wide-open eyes.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.37.desc: Sweet eyes with a stretched tip.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.39.desc: Large irises with a gleam and stretched lashes.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.40.desc: Stretched lashes and a soft light on the lid.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.41.desc: A gleaming iris with stretched lashes.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.42.desc: Lashes, white and a two-tone iris.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.43.desc: A wide lid over open eyes, with a soft light.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.44.desc: Broad eyes with a gleam in the iris.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.45.desc: Broad eyes, a gleam and stretched lashes.
character.lasthorizon.eye_style.46.desc: An iris with a narrow black pupil.

character.lasthorizon.eye_style.48.desc: Large eyes with the white clearly showing.

character.lasthorizon.eye_style.51.desc: Huge eyes with black pupils and a pale rim.
commands.lasthorizon.devilfruit.status.c: %s does not carry the Devil Fruit mark.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.full: Limit of %s items. Remove one to pick another.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.0.desc: A tiny ring at the tip of the right eyebrow (silver or gold).
character.lasthorizon.adorn.1.desc: A metal glint on the nostril (silver or gold).
character.lasthorizon.adorn.2.desc: A ring between the nostrils (silver or gold).
character.lasthorizon.adorn.3.desc: A ring just below the mouth (silver or gold).
character.lasthorizon.adorn.4.desc: Painted lips. You choose the color.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.5.desc: A bandage strip across the nose.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.6.desc: A patch from a past brawl on the left cheek.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.7.desc: A gem on the forehead, in your eye color.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.8.desc: A blue tear painted under the right eye.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.9.desc: A pink blush on the cheeks.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.10.desc: A small dark mark beside the mouth.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.11.desc: Gold and white sparkles on the cheekbones.
character.lasthorizon.pierce.0.desc: A tiny ring at the tip of the left eyebrow (silver or gold).
character.lasthorizon.pierce.1.desc: A metal glint on the left nostril (silver or gold).
character.lasthorizon.pierce.2.desc: A bar across the bridge of the nose, between the eyes.
character.lasthorizon.pierce.3.desc: A stud above the lip, on the left side.
character.lasthorizon.pierce.4.desc: A stud in the middle of the chin, just below the mouth.
character.lasthorizon.pierce.5.desc: Two studs, one at each lower corner of the mouth.
character.lasthorizon.pierce.6.desc: Two rings on the right eyebrow.
character.lasthorizon.extra.0.desc: An old, healed cut through the left eyebrow.
character.lasthorizon.extra.1.desc: A thin mark running down from the corner of the mouth, from an old fight.
character.lasthorizon.extra.2.desc: An old cut across the chin, just below the mouth.
character.lasthorizon.extra.3.desc: Two parallel slashes on the left cheek, from facing a beast.
character.lasthorizon.extra.4.desc: A pale diagonal scar on the forehead.
character.lasthorizon.extra.5.desc: Tight, reddened skin on the right cheek, from an explosion or fire.
character.lasthorizon.extra.6.desc: A fresh scar stitched shut on the left cheek, the thread still crossing it.
character.lasthorizon.extra.7.desc: A wine-colored patch on the right cheek.
character.lasthorizon.extra.8.desc: A zigzag of dark ink on the left cheek.
character.lasthorizon.extra.9.desc: Three small dots of ink under the left eye.
character.lasthorizon.extra.11.desc: A yellow star painted on the right cheek.
character.lasthorizon.extra.12.desc: A shadow of stubble on the chin and jaw, not quite a beard.
character.lasthorizon.extra.13.desc: A bruise around the right eye, fading to yellow at the edges.
character.lasthorizon.extra.14.desc: Smudges of gunpowder and soot across the face.
character.lasthorizon.extra.15.desc: A red cut on the right cheek, with dried blood trailing down.
character.lasthorizon.extra.16.desc: A bandage on the forehead, above the right eye.
character.lasthorizon.extra.17.desc: A line of shadow in your eye color above each eye.
character.lasthorizon.extra.19.desc: Nose and cheeks red from the cold.
character.lasthorizon.extra.20.desc: A light shine on the lips. You choose the color.
character.lasthorizon.adorn.off.lip: Click to wear · pick the color below
character.lasthorizon.metal.desc: Applies to all face piercings (eyebrow, nose, lip and chin).
character.lasthorizon.metal.title: Face piercings

character.lasthorizon.ear_metal.0.title: Left ear metal

character.lasthorizon.ear_metal.1.title: Right ear metal
character.lasthorizon.lip.label: Lip color
character.lasthorizon.paint.label: Paint color
character.lasthorizon.facex.0.desc: Two subtle dimples beside the mouth.
character.lasthorizon.facex.1.desc: Thick, bold eyebrows in the hair color.
character.lasthorizon.facex.2.desc: One eyebrow arched high, a suspicious look.
character.lasthorizon.facex.3.desc: Two lines on each cheek and a pink muzzle.
character.lasthorizon.facex.4.desc: A wide smile with teeth showing.
character.lasthorizon.facex.5.desc: A smile with a gold tooth, pirate style.
character.lasthorizon.facex.6.desc: One corner of the mouth higher than the other.

character.lasthorizon.extra.23.desc: A cartilage piercing at the top of the ear.
character.lasthorizon.extra.24.desc: A small stud in front of the ear.

character.lasthorizon.extra.30.desc: Red stripes across both arms, marks of someone who defended themselves.

character.lasthorizon.extra.32.desc: A purplish, scabbed wound on the left shoulder.

character.lasthorizon.extra.35.desc: Two slashes crossing in an X on the back, and a scratch below.
character.lasthorizon.extra.36.desc: Burnt, tight skin around the left eye, reaching up to the temple.

character.lasthorizon.ear_side.2.desc: Ear piercings only on the character's right ear.

character.lasthorizon.ear_item.1.desc: A small stud on the lobe.
character.lasthorizon.ear_item.2.desc: Cartilage piercing at the top of the ear.

character.lasthorizon.ear_item.5.desc: A long drop that dangles below the lobe.
